limitations: Purpose semantic judgments (applicable_limit_judgment, monitoring_obligation_judgment, missing_evidence_judgment) are not persisted in World; purpose_ir outputs are compiled by derive_purposes.py from World relations only.
DMR LIMIT_VALUE_ID association is not a World relation column; single-candidate selection cannot use explicit DMR limit linkage.
Schedule-only monitoring expectation slots without DMR rows are not in monitoring_expectation_without_numeric_result.
Purpose B cannot resolve condition-dependent requirements without FY2025 operational/discharge facts absent from World.
Purpose C NODI-code semantics without documented_no_discharge_notation remain unresolved even when NODI is present.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical temporal and facility-scope filter; does not infer missing measurements or establish purpose applicability.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is all reported_measurement_stated rows for in-scope facilities with monitoring period end in Federal FY2025 (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30 inclusive).
derivations.required_premise: reported_measurement_stated tuple exists with period_end within FY2025 window and facility in {NM0020583, NM0028762, NM0000116}.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Classifies whether a DMR row carries an ordinary numeric result suitable for Purpose A comparison; NODI-only or blank numeric fields yield false without compliance meaning.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: One output tuple per reported_measurement_stated row.
derivations.required_premise: reported_measurement_stated with nodi_code empty and value_number or standard_value present (not sentinel -999999999.0).

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical join of in-scope measurements to temporally overlapping enforceable-numeric ACCEPT limits sharing facility, discharge point, and parameter; emits all candidates without selecting a single applicable limit.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is fy2025_in_scope_measurement; candidate set is all enforceable-numeric ACCEPT permit_limit_value_stated rows overlapping the measurement period on locational keys.
derivations.required_premise: fy2025_in_scope_measurement plus matching permit_limit_value_stated with period_end within limit begin/end dates and limit_source_classification classification=enforceable-numeric disposition=ACCEPT.
blocking_unresolved_state: limit_source_classification UNRESOLVED for a limit row prevents that limit from entering the candidate set (non-blocking for derivation execution; may reduce candidates).

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical unit, statistical-base, and numeric-presence gate; ineligible pairs carry ineligibility_reason without purpose-level substitution.
derivations.required_premise: candidate_limit_for_measurement with measurement and limit rows joinable; eligible when unit_code and statistical_base match and both standard_value and limit_value_number are non-sentinel.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Mechanical arithmetic comparison when numeric_comparison_eligible is true, respecting limit qualifier direction (<=, >=, =); does not emit rows where eligibility is false.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Subset of candidate_limit_for_measurement where numeric_comparison_eligible.eligible = true.
derivations.required_premise: numeric_comparison_eligible.eligible = true for the measurement/limit pair.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Enumerates monitoring requirements whose stated schedule window overlaps Federal FY2025 for in-scope facilities; does not resolve whether monitoring was actually required.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is monitoring_requirement_stated rows overlapping FY2025 for selected facilities.
derivations.required_premise: monitoring_requirement_stated with begin/end dates overlapping 2024-10-01..2025-09-30 and facility in scope.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Identifies FY2025 DMR rows lacking ordinary numeric results for Purpose C; does not enumerate schedule-only expectation slots without DMR rows.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is fy2025_in_scope_measurement where measurement_has_ordinary_numeric_value is false.
derivations.optional_enrichment: monitoring_requirement_stated may enrich expectation identity but is not required for DMR-sourced expectations.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose A applicability selection among enforceable-numeric candidates; ACCEPT when exactly one eligible limit; REJECT when comparison is not applicable (report-only/non-enforceable for measurement statistical base); UNRESOLVED when multiple eligible limits or indeterminate join.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: One judgment per fy2025_in_scope_measurement with measurement_has_ordinary_numeric_value true.
derivations.optional_enrichment: None in World; DMR LIMIT_VALUE_ID linkage is absent from World IR.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Compiles applicable_limit_judgment into purpose_ir/a/output.json rows (resolved ACCEPT/REJECT) and unresolved arrays; preserves uncertainty without closed-world negation.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Receipt against all in-scope FY2025 measurements with ordinary numeric values.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Purpose B three-way classification (required, not_required, unresolved); does not infer not-required from absent monitoring reports; condition-sensitive requirements blocked without FY2025 condition facts.
derivations.optional_enrichment: permit_condition_language_stated informs unresolved reason text but does not alone establish required or not_required without operational facts.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Compiles monitoring_obligation_judgment into purpose_ir/b/output.json; current World evidence yields unresolved for all candidates.
Purpose C taxonomy assignment; documented_no_discharge when World notation exists; NODI without established semantics stays unresolved; does not infer compliance or violation from absence alone.
derivations.optional_enrichment: documented_no_discharge_notation establishes documented_no_discharge; monitoring_obligation_judgment would gate required_monitoring_inadequate_evidence but is not resolved in current World.
non_blocking_unresolved_state: documented_no_discharge (resolved to rows when documented_no_discharge_notation matches)

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Compiles missing_evidence_judgment into purpose_ir/c/output.json rows and unresolved arrays.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Receipt against monitoring_expectation_without_numeric_result universe (DMR-sourced non-numeric FY2025 rows only).
